name: General Poor Class Scholarship (Class 6 to 8)
benefit:
- Girl students will receive a scholarship of ₹300/- per year.
  - Boy students will receive a scholarship of ₹200/- per year.

**Note:** The scholarship amount is directly transferred to the student&#39;s bank account.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh.
   1. The applicant should be studying in Class 6 to 8.
   1. The student should be studying at a government school.
   1. The student should belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
   1. The student&#39;s parents&#39; total income from all sources should be less than ₹1,00,000/- per year.
   1. The student should have passed the previous class.
